cohort: Children in two prospective cohorts in southern China, followed from birth up to 5 years of age.
finding: Maternal EV-A71 antibody titres declined rapidly in neonates, leading to over half becoming susceptible by 1 month and over 80% susceptible between 6 months and 2 years of age, with the highest incidence of EV-A71 infections observed in children aged 5-6 months.
